# Task P0-08: Frontend shell

**Phase:** 0 · **Depends on:** P0-07, P0-08a · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** M

## Goal
An *arr-style React shell — Library, Wanted, Activity, Settings, System — that boots from `/initialize.json`, talks to `/api/v1` with the API key through TanStack Query hooks and generated OpenAPI types, receives live events over SignalR, supports light/dark themes, and builds into the API host's `wwwroot` so it works under any URL base.

## Deliverables
`frontend/` (Node ≥ 22.12; npm; ES modules):
- `package.json` — exact versions (already resolved; do not look them up). Dependencies: `react` 19.3.0, `react-dom` 19.3.0, `@mantine/core` 9.6.3, `@mantine/hooks` 9.6.3, `@mantine/notifications` 9.6.3, `@tanstack/react-query` 5.104.0, `react-router` 8.4.0, `openapi-fetch` 0.17.0, `@microsoft/signalr` 10.0.11, `lucide-react` 1.48.0. Dev: `vite` 8.3.1, `@vitejs/plugin-react` 6.1.1, `typescript` 5.9.3, `@types/react` 19.3.0, `@types/react-dom` 19.3.0, `openapi-typescript` 7.13.0, `vitest` 5.0.2, `jsdom` 30.1.1, `@testing-library/react` 16.3.3, `@testing-library/jest-dom` 7.0.1, `@testing-library/user-event` 14.6.7, `eslint` 10.11.0, `@eslint/js` 10.0.1, `typescript-eslint` 8.70.1, `eslint-plugin-react-hooks` 7.1.1, `eslint-plugin-react-refresh` 0.5.7, `globals` 17.12.0, `prettier` 3.9.9, `postcss` 8.5.28, `postcss-preset-mantine` 1.18.0, `postcss-simple-vars` 7.0.1. Scripts: `dev`, `build` (`tsc -b && vite build`), `typecheck` (`tsc -b --pretty false`), `lint` (`eslint . --max-warnings 0`), `format` (`prettier --check .`), `test` (`vitest run`), `gen:api` (`openapi-typescript ../docs/api/openapi.json -o src/api/schema.d.ts`). `engines.node` `>=22.12`. Commit `package-lock.json`.
- `vite.config.ts`: React plugin; `base: './'`; `build.outDir: '../src/Compilarr.Api/wwwroot'`, `emptyOutDir: true`; dev server port 5173 proxying `/api`, `/signalr` (ws), `/initialize.json`, `/login`, `/logout`, `/docs` to `http://localhost:1077`; `test` block for Vitest (jsdom, setup file with `@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest`).
- `index.html` with `<base href="__URL_BASE__/">` (the server replaces it — see P0-08a) and in dev a tiny inline fallback that sets `<base href="/">` when the placeholder is still present.
- `tsconfig*.json` with `strict: true`; ESLint flat config (`typescript-eslint` `recommendedTypeChecked`, react-hooks, react-refresh; `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any: error`); Prettier config; `postcss.config.cjs` for Mantine.
- `src/api/`: `schema.d.ts` generated by `npm run gen:api` (commit it); `bootstrap.ts` fetches `initialize.json` (relative URL, so it follows the base) into a typed `AppConfig { apiRoot, apiKey, urlBase, instanceName, version }` and redirects to `login` on 401/302-to-login; `client.ts` creates an `openapi-fetch` client with `baseUrl` = origin + `urlBase` and a middleware adding `X-Api-Key`; query hooks `useSystemStatus`, `useHealth`, `useTasks`, `useRunCommand` (mutation posting `{ name }` to `/api/v1/command`). All data access goes through these hooks.
- `src/app/`: `main.tsx` (bootstrap → render), `App.tsx` with `MantineProvider` (default color scheme `auto`), `Notifications`, `QueryClientProvider`, router `createBrowserRouter` with `basename` = `urlBase || '/'`; `signalr.ts` — connect to `signalr/events` (relative to the base) with `accessTokenFactory` → apiKey and automatic reconnect; on `receiveMessage` with `name: "health"` set the `['health']` query data, with `name: "command"` invalidate `['tasks']`.
- `src/components/AppLayout.tsx`: Mantine `AppShell` with a navbar (Library, Wanted, Activity, Settings, System; lucide icons), header with the instance name, a health badge (count of non-`ok` health entries) and a light/dark toggle (`useMantineColorScheme`).
- `src/pages/`: `LibraryPage`, `WantedPage`, `ActivityPage`, `SettingsPage` as empty states ("Arrives in Phase 1"); `system/StatusPage` (table of `/api/v1/system/status` fields: version, runtime, OS, Docker, database, URL base, start time, authentication) plus the health list with coloured badges; `system/TasksPage` (table of `/api/v1/system/task` with interval, last/next run, last result and a "Run now" button using `useRunCommand`). Routes: `/library`, `/wanted`, `/activity`, `/settings`, `/system/status`, `/system/tasks`; `/` redirects to `/library`; unknown routes show a not-found page. Every data page has loading, empty and error states.
- `src/theme/theme.ts`: Mantine theme (primary color, font stack). No ad-hoc CSS beyond CSS modules for layout.
- Tests (`src/**/*.test.tsx`, Vitest + Testing Library, `fetch` mocked; no network): navigation between all five sections; `StatusPage` renders `appName`/`version` from a mocked status response and an error state when the request fails; `TasksPage` "Run now" posts `{ name: "Heartbeat" }`; theme toggle flips the color scheme; health badge shows the count of non-ok entries.

## Allowed paths
- `frontend/**`
- Nothing else. (`src/Compilarr.Api/wwwroot/` is git-ignored build output.)

## Context to read first
- `docs/build/CODING_STANDARDS.md` (Frontend), `docs/architecture/STACK.md` §8.3 (Frontend row), `docs/build/tasks/P0-08a.md` (URL-base strategy)
- `docs/api/openapi.json`, `src/Compilarr.Api/Authentication/InitializeController.cs`, `src/Compilarr.Api/SignalR/*.cs`

## Constraints
- Use only the packages listed; `npm install` them with `--save-exact`. No `any` types.
- Relative URLs only (`initialize.json`, `signalr/events`, API via `apiRoot`), never hard-coded `/`-rooted paths, so the URL base keeps working.
- Run `npm run gen:api` against the committed `docs/api/openapi.json`; do not edit `schema.d.ts` by hand.

## Acceptance criteria (each must be demonstrated)
1. In `frontend/`: `npm ci`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build` all succeed (paste the final lines); `npm run format` passes.
2. `npm run build` writes `../src/Compilarr.Api/wwwroot/index.html` (containing `__URL_BASE__`) and hashed files under `wwwroot/assets/`.
3. The tests listed under Deliverables exist and pass.
4. `grep -rn "any" src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx` shows no `any` type annotations (explain any false positives).

## Out of scope
- Real Library/Wanted/Activity/Settings content (Phase 1+); settings forms rendered from schema (Phase 1); login page styling (server-rendered in P0-04).

## Done-report
Use the format in `docs/build/WORKER_SYSTEM_PROMPT.md`.
